decisions.reason: The source changes the token identifier shown in mint-result feedback; it does not change the required USDC approval-to-mint flow.
The incorrect success popup and token identifier do not alter which payment methods are enabled, displayed, or selectable.
The source concerns feedback during a USDC approval attempt and does not change the ETH mint-flow requirement.
Correcting the token identifier in success feedback does not change mint pricing or revenue allocation.
The source describes a connected-wallet USDC approval and popup issue, not the deferred Transak fiat-mint flow.
The source does not change ETH pricing, swap behavior, shortfall handling, or excess-refund rules.
The mint-result token identifier has no effect on the optional gratuity feature or its configured amounts.
Displaying the current confirmed mint's token ID does not alter the NFT ebook format or unlimited edition supply.
The source requires corrected runtime feedback but does not direct any change to the approved FAQ copy.
The popup's token identifier does not change the rule that referral codes must identify NFTs confirmed before checkout.
Mint-result feedback is unrelated to ebook rendering or reader navigation.
The source changes which token ID appears in the mint-success popup, not the NFT's permanent referral-code identity or its established referral-code display locations.
